questions.title: Comparable Less Than Output
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Box
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :v
  def initialize(v) @v = v end
  def <=>(other) @v <=> other.v end
end
puts Box.new(3) < Box.new(5)

questions.title: Extend Class Method Output
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.Option2: error: undefined method hi for Bot:Class
questions.codesnippet:
module Greet
  def hi; "hi" end
end
class Bot
  extend Greet
end
puts Bot.hi

questions.title: Prepend Super Output
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
module M
  def speak; "M-" + super end
end
class C
  prepend M
  def speak; "C" end
end
puts C.new.speak

questions.title: Enumerable Map Output
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Bag
  include Enumerable
  def each
    yield 1
    yield 2
    yield 3
  end
end
puts Bag.new.map { |x| x * 2 }.join(",")

questions.title: Multiple Prepend Order
questions.description: What does the following snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
module X
  def go; "X" + super end
end
module Y
  def go; "Y" + super end
end
class S
  prepend X
  prepend Y
  def go; "S" end
end
puts S.new.go

questions.title: Comparable Descending Sort
questions.description: What does the following snippet print? The `<=>` is reversed on purpose.
questions.codesnippet:
class P
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :s
  def initialize(s) @s = s end
  def <=>(o) o.s <=> s end
end
arr = [P.new(3), P.new(1), P.new(2)]
puts arr.sort.map(&:s).join(",")
